description: This file declares the IpcFactory class which implements the IIpcFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create application management and session management server objects within the Rialto server IPC namespace.

classes.name: IpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating IPC server components such as application and session management servers.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IApplicationManagementServer, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionManagementServer, given playback, cdm, and control services.
